channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Man, 72, dies after being struck by vehicle in Kalihi driveway
item.description: A collision in a Kalihi driveway on Tuesday night claimed the life of a 72-year-old man, marking Oahu’s first fatal non-traffic pedestrian motor vehicle collision of 2026.

item.title: Woman, 93, dies after being struck by vehicle in Liliha crosswalk
item.description: A 93-year-old woman has died following a collision in Liliha early this morning, marking Oahu’s seventh traffic fatality of 2026.

item.title: Tulsi Gabbard winds down intelligence task force
item.description: WASHINGTON >> U.S. spy chief Tulsi Gabbard told Reuters on Tuesday that she has wound down a task force she launched last year with the declared goal of rooting out politicization from intelligence agencies, but which critics accused of being a tool for partisan attacks by the Trump administration.

item.title: Epstein revelations stir chaos from Scandinavia to South Asia
item.description: PARIS >> A French politician, famed as a cultural icon of the 1980s and 1990s. A Norwegian diplomat who played a role in the secret talks that yielded the Oslo Accords between Israel and the Palestinians. A well-connected Slovak former minister who served as president of the United Nations General Assembly.

item.title: ‘Dawson’s Creek’ star James Van Der Beek dies at 48
item.description: James Van Der Beek, the star of 1990s teen drama “Dawson’s Creek,” died today at the age of 48 after a battle with cancer, his wife announced on social media.

item.title: Hawaii island police identify Honokaa man killed in ATV rollover
item.description: Hawaii island police have identified the man who died in an all-terrain-vehicle vehicle rollover late Saturday night as 41-year-old Kasey Hui-Ahsam of Honokaa.

item.title: Lawmakers accuse Bondi of hiding names of Epstein associates
item.description: WASHINGTON >> A Republican lawmaker today accused Attorney General Pam Bondi of concealing the names of powerful associates of the late financier and convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein as she faced questions about the Justice Department’s handling of investigative files in a charged hearing before a House of Representatives panel.

item.title: Madison Chock and Evan Bates take silver in Olympic ice dance today
item.description: MILAN >> After injuries and stumbles, Madison Chock and Evan Bates earned their first Olympic medal today, but it wasn’t expected to be this color.

item.title: Fans turn out for Seattle Seahawks Super Bowl victory parade
item.description: SEATTLE >> Hundreds of thousands of Seattle Seahawks fans crowded Lumen Field and the streets of downtown Seattle on Wednesday to celebrate the football team’s Super Bowl win in what felt like a blue-and-green citywide party.

item.title: ‘This kidnapping violates all the rules’: Why cracking the Nancy Guthrie case has been so hard
item.description: Authorities got a huge break on Tuesday with the release of footage of an armed individual wearing a balaclava, gloves and a backpack approaching the front door of Guthrie’s Arizona home and tampering with a Nest camera the morning she was abducted.
